craft_notes: Sthāyin: charter — dispensation energy (owner reviews first-verse of chapter). Sanskrit-first: triple-na kept as falling triple. Rows: 3. Close: anywhere stands. Rejected: softening the shedding — killed: three negations are the verse. Read aloud: muster cadence — falls, falls, falls, stands.

lines: Short road, high goal — dust and eve-rite fall,
field-claim falls; worship stands anywhere at all.
